scope: Exact native integer lattice LLL with guarded public DDM/DomainMatrix routes; exact DomainElement floor/ceil for stock ZZ/QQ and stored finite RR; native read-only rational protocol-state verification and builtin-owner bootstrap correction.

source_identity.scope: Code, tests, audit fixtures, package configuration and native binary; documentation excluded

rust.validation_mode: Fresh complete execution on the new native inputs; no Rust result reuse.

intentional_corrections: DomainElement floor/ceil no longer downcasts stock exact QQ/ZZ or admitted stored finite RR values through binary64. The single existing RR150 targeted expectation is strengthened to the exact dyadic inequality; 75 QQ/ZZ and108 RR cases remain present.

Native LLL uses exact floor(mu+1/2). On nine archived large-integer cases unmodified SymPy1.14/oldSymox raises3 assertions or yields6 different valid bases; all651 original outcomes plus independent exact T*A=B, determinant and Gram-Schmidt/Lovasz certificates are retained. Speed is not claimed against these incorrect/incomplete baselines.
remaining_gaps: Global mathematical parity is not certified.

LLL cold calls or invalid classifier caches can retain the whole established Python algorithm; warm admitted stock integer matrices use the Rust kernel. LU/FFLU, normal forms, sparse GJ and other preparations remain separate work.

Floor/ceil preserves existing custom float/index conversions and errors. CC/EX/composite/nonliteral routes remain existing fallbacks. Integer materialization above the unchanged MAX_INTEGER_SHIFT capacity reports OverflowError; arbitrary unbounded integer allocation is not claimed.

Native rational protocol-state verification replaces read-only identity loops only, with actual cells and signal propagation. Replaced dependencies resume the established Python verifier. Builtin owner authentication covers the recorded ordinary Python/C extension foreign-owner cases; no claim covers an explicitly fabricated malicious runtime.
General rational RootSum/higher-degree/other-domain drivers, broad Risch/PRDE/ODE and previous domain/precision/solution-completeness gaps remain open.

performance.status: Paired integrated release measurements complete; repeated gains and first-call regression both retained.
